title: Ice Arena
description: A frozen PvP arena map featuring intense battles, smooth gameplay, and a stunning icy atmosphere perfect for duels and practice fights.
body:
Welcome to Ice Arena — a frozen battlefield where every fight becomes a test of skill, movement, and survival! Built with a chilling icy theme, this PvP arena delivers intense combat inside a beautifully crafted frozen environment filled with snow, ice, and epic atmosphere.

The arena is designed for smooth and balanced gameplay, making it perfect for AxePvP, duels, practice fights, and multiplayer battles with friends. From slippery-looking frozen pathways to the cold blue aesthetic, every part of the map is made to create an exciting and immersive PvP experience.

Sharpen your aim, master your movement, and dominate the frozen arena!

Features
❄️ Unique icy/frozen arena theme
⚔️ Perfect for PvP, duels, and practice
🏟️ Detailed custom-built map
🚀 Smooth and optimized gameplay
🔥 Competitive and fun combat experience
